The current set is baseline‑only, so we add a weighted/selection candidate (best_per_horizon_by_validation) and a weighted combination (dba_combination). To further diversify, I add inverse_rmse_weights_k10_sh0.35 (inverse RMSE weighting) and trimmed_mean_r0.20 (a new trimming level that matches the global trim_ratio). No candidates are removed to preserve the baseline coverage.
